On one engagement, I found an SMB NULL session using the  enum4linux  tool and retrieved both a listing of  all  users from the domain, and the domain  password policy . Knowing the password policy was crucial because I could ensure that I was staying within the parameters to not lock out any accounts and also knew that the policy was a minimum eight-character password and password complexity was enforced (meaning that a user's password required 3/4 of special character, number, uppercase, or lower case number, i.e., Welcome1).
